params.for_goal: Make the Law of the System (akasha [C22]) actually FIRE for every future amnesic agent — not merely be written down.

context_lock.context: /enhance Ultrathink 2026-07-15; the operator's Law-of-the-System directive turned into a law (akasha rule + [C22]) + a fire-point (anti-theater Layer-5 R9) + an executable (this skill, ooda-loop ORIENT-b).
context_lock.purpose: close the construct-the-vehicle gap in the ooda-loop typed set so a driver stops improvising its recurring action each round.
context_lock.priority_focus: the law must fire, not merely exist — a law with no firing mechanism IS intention without action (it would violate itself).
context_lock.stakeholder: operator (Eko/C8it) + every future amnesic agent that inherits the corpus.
context_lock.targets: primary: ooda-loop DECIDE consumes a third envelope; secondary: R9 fires at anti-theater Layer-5; auxiliary: >=2 dogfood cycles before promotion.

minimal_system.trigger: IF anti-theater Layer-5 R9 fires — the action is a step toward a stated/given/self-imposed goal AND no vehicle exists yet
minimal_system.action: THEN derive one minimal recurring step (its trigger + cadence) and emit this envelope BEFORE acting
minimal_system.why_minimal: the cost is one derivation (~1 tool call, seconds) on an action ALREADY paused at the gate. It cannot reasonably be refused: refusing means acting on a goal you just admitted has no vehicle — the refusal costs strictly more than the compliance.
minimal_system.cadence: once per goal-pursuit entry; re-derived ONLY when revision_trigger fires — re-deriving every round would be the ceremony the Gordian floor forbids

params.adherence_signal: Two-part, Metron-admissible (never a run-count): (a) does R9 still FIRE on goal-pursuit actions — is the mechanism alive? AND (b) does emitting the envelope still CHANGE what the driver does that round — does firing still move the goal? Both yes = healthy. First no = the gate went dormant. Second no = the vehicle is decorative.
params.revision_trigger: R9 fires and the envelope is emitted across N consecutive goal-pursuits, yet the driver's behavior stays indistinguishable from improvising => the VEHICLE is wrong (re-derive it), NOT the driver. This is the Eliason guard the source video lacks.
params.consumed_as: driver positional "<instructions>": minimal_system.action is the string appended to the goal (gap-loop SKILL.md:194). No flag for 'the recurring action' exists; inventing one would be interface fabrication (anti-theater R4).
